observations.S03.jpg: Distant battle view with heavy spray/smoke; useful scene silhouette only, not a top-plan or detailed gun position proof.
observations.S08.png: Later-date underside/edge close view; supports cantilever truss/edge-net relation only; not whole-ship 1941 layout proof.
observations.M01-page-2.png: Tamiya 1993 model paint side/top plan: useful reconstruction cross-check with photos, not historical primary calibrated drawing. Shows asymmetric island/funnels and individual main-gun platforms, inboard elevators, no modern angled deck.
